name: skills
description: Design and polish UI screens and states (ux), ship PRs end-to-end with CI and deploy gates (deploy), and tidy recently changed code without changing behavior (simplify).

interface.shortDescription: UI design, end-to-end PR shipping, and code cleanup skills
interface.longDescription: Three skills for AI coding agents: ux designs and polishes screens, flows, states and landing pages while keeping PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md in sync; deploy ships finished work through CI, staging, migrations and production gates; simplify refines recently modified code without changing behavior.
capabilities: Design and polish UI screens, states and flows (/ux)
Ship finished work through CI, staging and production (/deploy)
Refine recently changed code without changing behavior (/simplify)
defaultPrompt: Polish the states and copy of the screen I just changed.
Deploy this branch to staging and watch the checks.
Simplify the code modified on this branch.
